sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Solitude is unbearable. Desire for company.
Complains about his condition. Anguish. Discontented.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Headache alternates with gastralgia. Neu-
ralgic pain, as if torn by pincers; involves face and
teeth ; worse, eating ; better, cold ; alternate with gas-
tralgia. Cutting or pressure above right orbit extend-
ing to occiput. Pressure in occiput; worse, motion;
with heaviness.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Gums swollen. Toothache ; better, cold
water in mouth. [Coff.] Tongue white. Swollen.
Black, gangrenous looking wedges on dorsum and sides
of tongue. Profuse salivation, teeth loose. Thirst for
cold drinks.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Vomits, with convulsive gagging and
pain. IVatrr is vomited as soon as it reaches the

sections.label: stomach
sections.text:
Eructation after drinking. Vomits all fluids.
Htdriting; feeling of a load. Will eat for several days;
then vomit. Slow digestion, with fetid eructations.
Gastralgia; pain from stomach through to spine. Gas-
tritis. Better, cold drinks, but vomiting when stomach
becomes full.

Tongue coated white; sweetish, metallic taste. In-
expressible pain in stomach ; must bend backwards.
Pressure as from a load in one spot, alternating with
burning, crampy pain and pyrosis.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Painless diarrhoea, with great thirst, and fre-
quent micturition and vomiting. Pinching in lower
abdomen, with rumbling.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Pinching in middle of diaphragm, exi-
tending transversely through chest. Angina pectoris;
pain around heart, left arm to fingers. ' \ ^ .

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Cramps in hands and feet. Tearing
in wrist. Paralytic weakness, especially right arm.
Tearing in tips of fingers under nails. [Bcrb.] Itching
erosion near tibia and back of feet near joints. Cold

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Restless on account of voluptuous dreams.
Sleepy in morning, a few hours after eating.

sections.text:
